proposed_facts.reason: Canonical copy geometry matches the proposal. GXSetDispCopyDst ignores ht and programs width-derived stride; GXSetDispCopyYScale independently returns a calculated line count.

The canonical callback has the stated signature. The VI handler increments retraceCount in software and supplies it to both callbacks; HSD forwards it unchanged.
